subject: Emotions
title: Disgust as Creative Fuel
description: A fast breakdown of Disgust as Creative Fuel for builders.

hook.text: Horror films gross $10 billion a year. We pay to feel the emotion we normally avoid.

buildup.text: Artists like Damien Hirst use rotting animals in glass cases. Disgust grabs attention no other emotion can.

discovery.text: 'Benign violation theory' explains it. Safe disgust—in art, comedy, food—is thrilling, not traumatic.

twist.text: Stand-up comedians use gross-out humor to build intimacy. Shared disgust bonds audiences faster than joy.

climax.text: The most memorable art often provokes disgust. It bypasses intellect and hits the body directly.

punchline.text: Great art doesn't always please you. Sometimes it revolts you.

quiz.question: What theory explains why safe disgust is enjoyable?
